title: Production-line measurement record
description: The shared machine-readable shape every ADR-090 emitter maps its native record onto. This is a contract, not a storage schema: ADR-061, ADR-059 and ADR-036 keep their own stores and authority. A dimension an emitter cannot authoritatively supply is absent — never synthesized, never defaulted, never copied from raw input.

measurementVersion.description: Version of this measurement contract the record was produced against.

emitter.description: Which emitter produced the record. Identifies the source, not the workflow.

observedAt.description: When the fact occurred, not when it was delivered. A late flush must never distort a duration.

runId.description: ADR-061 workflow_run.id. A reporting correlation, not workflow authority and not a distributed trace id.

stationId.description: Authoritative station id from the station catalogue. A SKILL step number, routing stage, marker value, or UI label is an alias and must be resolved before it reaches this field.

stationAttempt.description: Ordered attempt for one (run, station). Absent when the emitter cannot order attempts; a source with neither this nor a cycle index cannot contribute to iteration metrics.

boundaryId.description: Registered architecture/contract boundary this attempt inspected. A file path, package name, or display title is not a boundary id.

WorkItem.description: ADR-090 section 2: the exact GitHub-issue tuple. Requirement UIDs and PRs are related references, never replacements, and there is no branch-only or issue-number-only cross-repository join.

CapabilityTier.description: ADR-036 provider-neutral tier. `unobserved` is not evidence of `low`; `not_applicable` means no model choice applied. Provider and model are separate dimensions.

OperationOutcome.description: Axis 1 of ADR-090 section 3: whether an emitter operation ran. Never evidence that a gate passed. Shares no value with StationResult, so the two cannot be silently substituted.

StationResult.description: Axis 2 of ADR-090 section 3: the verdict of the thing a station inspected. Only this axis feeds yield and rework formulas. It is stated explicitly by the producer — never derived from a tool succeeding, from a phase completing, from a merged PR, or from the absence of a later failure. Legacy records that never carried a result are `unobserved` and are excluded from formula denominators rather than counted as passes.

RunState.description: Axis 3 of ADR-090 section 3: the ADR-061 run lifecycle state. `RUNNING` means no terminal observation has been recorded, not that a process is alive.

RunOutcome.description: Axis 3 of ADR-090 section 3: the ADR-061 economic result of a run.

x-ground-control-invariants.description: Operation outcome, station result, and run state/outcome are separate properties backed by separate closed enums that share no value. ADR-090 section 3's separation is enforced by construction: `pass` cannot appear on the operation axis, and `ok` cannot appear on the station axis, so no aggregate can conflate a tool succeeding with a gate passing.
stationId is a catalogue station id, so an alias can never be persisted as identity. Every station id the record schema admits is declared in the station catalogue.

Only measurementVersion, emitter and observedAt are required. Every correlation and outcome dimension is optional, so an emitter that cannot attest a dimension omits it rather than defaulting it to a value that would read as a real observation.
